people.imagined: At a table in the Boat Hall, hands closed, not singing, while the others sing. He has his grandfather's voice and uses it only to argue.
people.subject: The moment: in the lamplit Boat Hall he sits at a long table with his thick fists closed, glaring at the viewer and refusing to sing while the others raise the ninth verse around him. Face: a thick-set, square face with a heavy jaw; bronzed skin; hard dark eyes, slightly bloodshot; thick black brows; a flat nose; a tight mouth with the corners turned down; a short black beard that grows low on the cheeks. Hair: black, in a tight high knot held by a plain dark jade pin. Body: thickset and broad, shoulders hunched, elbows on the table. Clothing: three layers of flowing silk: a rust under-robe, a dusk-violet jacket with two crossed collars left open at the throat, and a sunset-gold gauze over-robe that falls from his shoulders in wide sleeves, the cuffs embroidered in gold with flying geese and one wine-coloured stain; a brass stern-lamp clasp at the collar and a dark jade pendant on his sash. Hands and objects: both big fists closed on the table; on the wall behind him a hanging stern lamp, unlit. Power: a heavy, sullen haze of ochre-brown earth qi settles around his shoulders, with a few dull gold motes sinking toward the table like silt. Background: a blurred hall of dark wood hung with boat oars and a row of unlit stern lamps, a sunset-coloured mist in the rafters. Light: dim amber lamplight from the upper left with a faint rim of violet spirit-light along his shoulder, leaving the other side of his face in shadow. Expression: bitter, vengeful and withdrawn, proud and grieving in the same set of the mouth.

people.imagined: On the drill ground at first light, rasping a command, unable to slouch. He has drawn a bean from his pocket and is looking at the left file.
people.subject: The moment: at first light on the drill ground he stands rigid with his mouth open in a rasping shout, holding up between finger and thumb a small black bean he has just drawn again from the left file. Face: a lean, hard, red-brown face; a clipped grey moustache cut square, the lower lip protruding; narrow stern eyes; heavy straight brows; a hawk nose; a taut mouth. Hair: grey-black, cropped short under a slim silver crown-band. Body: tall, stiff, ramrod straight, neck stiff and chin lifted like a man on parade. Clothing: layered silk in rust and dusk violet, the collars crossed tight and buttoned to the chin, wide sleeves bound at the wrist, sunset-gold gauze streaming from the shoulders and borders embroidered with flying geese in gold thread; a polished belt buckle and a small grey goose-feather pin at the collar, crooked by a hair. Hands and objects: the right hand holds up the black bean; the left fist is clenched at his hip. A well-made straight double-edged sword in an ochre-brown scabbard is slung diagonally across his back, its dull bronze guard and tan-cord grip showing above the right shoulder. Power: a stiff, restrained shimmer of earth qi in ochre and gold clings to his shoulders and the sword's scabbard, a few motes rising like dust in the dawn. Background: a blurred drill ground in pale dawn mist, lines of small rust-coloured figures, the leftmost three bowed. Light: cool gold dawn from the upper left with a thin rim of spirit-light along his jaw. Expression: harsh and rigid, arbitrary, with no pleasure in it.

people.imagined: Conducting the inner choir in summer with a red scarf at her neck, her long arms conducting even when she means them to be still. She is thinking of the missing tune.
people.subject: The moment: mid-conducting, both long arms lifted, she smiles broadly and turns her head to the viewer; the choir is on the high note and she conducts without knowing it, her mind on the missing tune. Face: a broad, warm, freckled face with light brown eyes, thick expressive brows, a wide mouth open in song and flushed cheeks, a small worried lift in the brows. Hair: chestnut, in a high bun held by a bone comb with three teeth missing, short curls springing loose at the nape. Body: tall, with unusually long arms, the sleeves riding up. Clothing: flowing rust silk with a dusk-violet jacket and crossed collars, the sleeves cut very wide so the arms swing free, hems embroidered with gold sunset clouds and flying geese, a stern-lamp clasp at the throat; around her neck a bright cherry-red scarf of soft silk knotted loosely twice, its ends hanging, clearly visible. Hands and objects: both arms raised and spread as if conducting, fingers curled. Power: faint ribbons of ochre and green qi follow the sweep of her sleeves like notes in the air, glittering as the choir climbs. Background: pillars of dark wood and three rows of singers in rust robes, blurred, with a haze of sunset-coloured light between the pillars. Light: a warm shaft from a high window crossing the front row and catching her cheekbone and the red of the scarf, with soft glow around her hands. Expression: joyous and warm, mouth open and cheeks bright, a stubborn devout woman who will not stop conducting until the tune comes back.

people.imagined: At the edge of the grey, smelling of lime, plaiting his beard. He has just lost another man to the miasma and is not saying so.
people.subject: The moment: at the edge of the miasma he looks past the viewer toward the grey with a stone face, a lantern just refilled at his belt, having lost another man and not saying so. Face (most important: a long grey beard plaited into several braids whitened with lime dust): a grim, heavy, weather-beaten face with ash-pale skin, deep-set small eyes, heavy grey brows, a big nose broken twice, and lime dust in the creases beside the eyes. Hair: grey, cropped short and whitened with lime, the beard plaits tied off with scraps of grey silk. Body: heavy, broad, solid and slow, with a slight sag in the knees from standing long. Clothing: an ash-grey robe of heavy silk with a dusk-violet collar edge and wide sleeves, a long grey gauze over-robe grey with dust, and over the chest a breastplate of overlapping earth-iron scales engraved with faint flying geese; a pale jade ring on his belt. Hands and objects: one thick hand grips a spade with white lime on its blade; a small lantern with a pale green flame hangs from the belt. Power: a slow, heavy swirl of ochre-brown earth qi circles his boots and the scales, a few gold motes sinking into the ground like ash. Background: a blurred grey ash plain and mist, a row of earth mounds each with a stick, and a raw mound of fresh earth. Light: pale grey-green spirit-light from the left with a faint cold rim along his beard. Expression: a hard, loyal weariness, the jaw set and the eyes dull, worn down to stone.

people.imagined: At the Counting House desk. A certain abacus clicks across the room and his ears go red. He rounds the next sum up and tells himself it is for her.
people.subject: The moment: at his desk in the Counting House he looks up at a sound out of frame, ears bright red, turning a half-embarrassed look on the viewer as the abacus clicks across the room. Face: a thin, earnest, youthful face; pale skin; a flush across the cheeks; big nervous brown eyes with long lashes; thin brows; a small mouth; a weak chin; two very red ears, clearly visible. Hair: black, in a tidy topknot with a plain ochre ribbon, ears fully uncovered. Body: thin and narrow, shoulders slightly hunched, elbows pulled in as he sits over the desk. Clothing: graceful layered silk, a pale ochre under-robe, a rust jacket with two neat crossed collars pinned precisely, and a thin sunset-gold gauze sleeve-cover tied back at each arm, the cuffs bordered in gold with tiny flying geese and one small ink stain. Hands and objects: one hand holds a brush above a blank sheet; the other rests on a small abacus with bone beads. Power: a few faint motes of ochre earth qi drift above the abacus, bobbing with each click, barely visible. Background: blurred shelves of lidded boxes and a hanging lamp, a window with a square of bright sky, a soft haze of gold dust in the air. Light: warm lamp glow from the upper left with a faint pink rim where it lights his ears. Expression: shy, flustered and secretly calculating, about to apologise to the air.

people.imagined: On the bow of a toll boat at the river mouth, squinting sidelong at a barge as a heron squints at a fish, counting.
people.subject: The moment: standing in the bow of a toll boat at the river mouth, she squints sidelong at the viewer the way a heron squints at a fish, silently counting the sacks of a passing barge. Face: a narrow, sharp, tanned face with a long nose, narrow sidelong dark eyes, thin straight brows, a small pursed mouth, faint wind lines, a long neck and a pointed chin. Hair: black, in a tight bun with a blue silk head-cloth knotted over it at the nape. Body: lean, long-necked and narrow-shouldered, standing a moment on one leg like a heron. Clothing: flowing rust silk with a dusk-violet jacket and crossed collars, a sea-grey gauze cloak lifting in the river wind and fastened with a brass pin, the wide sleeves tied back and bordered in gold with sunset clouds; a small silk pouch at her belt with coin shapes pushing out its sides. Hands and objects: both hands hold a long punting pole. Power: thin ribbons of ochre earth qi and pale blue water qi curl around the pole and her wrists, glimmering where they touch the water. Background: a wide river mouth of grey water in drifting sunset mist, a heavily laden barge sliding across under a square sail, a few pale herons far off. Light: cold bright river light from the upper left, silver water-glow flickering under her chin and soft rim light along her cloak. Expression: cool and calculating, the eyes narrowed to slits and the mouth pursed, her greed hidden behind perfect patience.

people.imagined: On a steppe road beside a wagon, a tarnished whistle at his throat that he blows to end arguments. He is padding a bill in his head.
people.subject: The moment: beside a laden wagon on a steppe road, he holds the tarnished whistle between his lips and gives the viewer a jovial look as the argument at the wagon rises. Face: a ruddy, broad, windburnt face; a big grin with a gold tooth showing at the side; small bright dark eyes; thick brows; a broken nose; stubble; cheeks cracked red by wind. Hair: black going grey, in a tight knot with a leather cord and a small jade bead. Body: thick, strong, a little paunchy, legs bowed from years in the saddle. Clothing: sturdy-looking layers of rust silk and a dusk-violet coat with crossed collars, dusty to the knee, a fur collar greyed by dust, wide sleeves with gold flying geese at the cuffs, and a sunset-gold gauze sash; a tarnished silver whistle on a cord at the throat, clearly visible. Hands and objects: one hand holds the whistle; the other holds a stack of tally sticks. Power: a rolling haze of ochre earth qi and a few gold motes float around his shoulders like road dust catching the sun. Background: yellow steppe grass under drifting gold mist, a line of heavy wagons and patient oxen along a pale yellow road. Light: bright warm light from the upper left with a soft golden rim along his shoulders. Expression: jovial, shrewd and greedy, jolly but with eyes that keep moving across the viewer's purse.

people.imagined: On the road with a letter case, she has just resealed a letter and slid her hand into the secret pocket of her cloak, a pleasant smile in place.
people.subject: The moment: on a road between two vassals she slips a letter into a pocket sewn inside her cloak and smiles pleasantly at the viewer, having just broken a seal and closed it again with a warm thumb. Face: a smooth, pretty, fair face; soft cheeks; clever light-brown eyes; fine arched brows; a small sweet smile; a mole by the nose; small pink ears. Hair: glossy black, in a neat low coil with a jade pin and a thin gold hairchain. Body: slender and graceful, walking with small even steps. Clothing: flowing rust silk with crossed collars and wide sleeves bordered in gold with flying geese, a dusk-violet travel cloak of soft gauze lined with grey, its collar edged with pale fur and its inner lining showing a hidden pocket opened at the breast, clearly visible. Hands and objects: soft, clean, unscarred clerk's hands, one sliding a folded paper into the pocket, the corner of the letter showing. Power: faint green and ochre motes of qi drift from her sleeve like pollen, almost hidden in the folds of the cloak. Background: a pale road running through a green plain to a small gate, soft grey sky with a sunset-coloured mist along the horizon. Light: soft silvery light from the upper left with a gentle glow along the cloak's edge. Expression: sweet, deceptive and calm, with no sign of her thoughts.

people.imagined: Beside a steppe pond with a boat, the empty left sleeve pinned across his chest, teaching a boy to row one-handed. He is patient.
people.subject: The moment: seated in a small boat on a steppe pond he demonstrates a stroke with his one arm and looks at the viewer with a kindly steady gaze, a boy having just caught the stroke right and him nodding slowly. Face: a broad, weathered, kind face with deep smile lines, steady brown eyes, thick brows, grey stubble, a calm mouth and a scar running from the left ear down the neck. Hair: grey-black, in a plain topknot with a pale jade pin. Body: broad-chested and powerful on the right side, the left shoulder lower, the right arm thick as a post. Clothing: layered rust silk with a dusk-violet jacket and crossed collars, the borders embroidered with gold flying geese, the left sleeve empty and folded flat across the chest, pinned with a brass pin shaped like a small oar, clearly visible; a sunset-gold gauze sash trailing at the waist. Hands and objects: the right hand grips a long oar, the knuckles strong. Power: a calm, steady ripple of ochre earth qi moves about his shoulder and oar, and the pond water curls up faintly where the blade touches it. Background: a grassy pond bank with reed beds ringing a still pond mirroring a pale sky, a grey boat tilting at a jetty, a gold evening mist. Light: soft golden light from the upper left, shimmering off the water onto his chin. Expression: patient, calm and forgiving, with humour in the lines at the corners of his eyes, a man who lost an arm and kept the rest of himself.

people.imagined: In the gallery lamplight tending a silver-pine prop; the lamp catches silver flecks in her eyelashes, and she blinks them slowly.
people.subject: The moment: beside a pillar of silver pine in lamplight she blinks slowly at the viewer, silver flecks glittering on her lashes, having paused between two props to rest a hand on the trunk as a mote of silver lands on her cheek. Face: a calm, thin, quiet face; pale skin; grey-green eyes; eyelashes bright with tiny silver flecks, clearly visible; straight light brows; a small mouth with a tiny scar across the upper lip. Hair: light brown, in a low knot with a pale pine pin, a silver speck on one strand beside her ear. Body: slim, small and gentle, standing with her head slightly bowed. Clothing: layered rust silk with a dusk-violet sash and two crossed collars, wide sleeves tied back with a thin cord and dusted with silver at the cuffs, gold flying geese along the borders, a sunset-gold gauze scarf over one shoulder; a thin brown thread looped round her wrist. Hands and objects: one hand rests on a pale silver-grey pine pole; the other holds a small brush; a small pot of pine pitch stands at her feet. Power: soft ochre and green qi drifts from the pine bark in slow motes like pollen, and the pole faintly glows where her palm rests. Background: a dark gallery of pale pine props each with a small hanging lamp, blurred, in drifting sunset mist. Light: warm amber lamplight from the upper left; where it touches the pine the bark gleams like wet silver. Expression: quiet, patient and reserved, gentle.

people.imagined: At a quay stall selling a printed chart of a star. She glances up at a ledge as she did as a nest-picker and sells the sky for a third boat.
people.subject: The moment: at a quay stall she holds up a printed chart of a star for a buyer who has stopped, glancing up at a roof ledge as she did when she was a nest-picker, and then at the viewer. Face: a narrow, sun-brown face; a long nose; wide watchful hazel eyes; thin brows; a small smile; a quick head tilt; one earlobe pierced with a tiny bone ring. Hair: black, in a high braid with a green silk string and a small silver comb. Body: slim, light and quick, standing on her toes. Clothing: flowing rust silk, sea-faded to a softer salt-pale rose, with a dusk-violet vest, crossed collars and wide sleeves bordered in gold with sunset clouds, and a sea-grey gauze scarf knotted at the side and fringed with silk tassels. Hands and objects: both hands hold up a large paper sea-chart marked with a ring of small printed stars, one circled in red, with no writing; a roll of charts at her belt. Power: a few pale ochre and blue motes drift around the chart as if the printed stars were faintly alive. Background: a quay of boats and tall masts in sea mist tinted sunset-gold, gulls wheeling above, a pale sea beyond. Light: bright sea light from the upper left, a soft glow lifting off the chart and a thin rim light on her braid. Expression: watchful, honest and quick.

people.imagined: At the doorway of the Hall of Scales, filling it. The children say he is a door that walks. He does not look away.
people.subject: The moment: standing square in a high doorway so that he fills it, arms at his sides, he looks straight at the viewer without moving, a small girl led before the Hall of Scales and he not looking away from the sentence; the children say he is a door that walks. Face: a huge, flat, expressionless face with a square jaw, pale scarred skin, a thin scar across the left cheekbone, calm black eyes that never move, thick straight brows and a mouth like a slot. Hair: black, cropped very short under a plain dark jade crown. Body: enormous, very tall and very broad, shoulders nearly touching both sides of the frame. Clothing: the rich robes of an enforcer in layers of dusk-violet silk pressed without a single crease, two crossed collars with a stiff gold border, wide sleeves embroidered in gold with flying geese and a thin band of sunset-gold gauze across the chest, a rust sash knotted exactly in the centre. Hands and objects: one huge hand grips a plain dark staff of office with a black iron cap, as tall as himself; the other hangs open. Power: a heavy, still weight of ochre-brown earth qi presses gently outward from his shoulders, making the air about the doorframe seem dense, with slow gold motes. Background: a tall dark doorframe with a pale hall beyond in violet mist. Light: cool silver light from the upper left with a thin glowing rim on his shoulders. Expression: blank, just and immovable, a man to whom a sentence is only a sentence.

people.imagined: On the herb terraces. A pleasant smile arrives a moment before the thing it is for. She holds a bunch of leaves with a mark she should not have.
people.subject: The moment: on a terrace she gives the viewer a smile that arrives a moment too early and is held too long, selling leaves with a false mark. Face: a round, soft, pleasant face with rosy cheeks, warm brown eyes with a cool flicker in them, arched brows, a wide smile, a small dimple and faint crow's feet. Hair: brown, in a neat bun with a pressed red maple leaf pinned in it and a small gold hairpin. Body: plump, comfortable and relaxed, one hip against a terrace wall, the free hand hanging loose, with the soft rounded shoulders of someone who has never hurried a day. Clothing: layered rust silk with a dusk-violet vest and two crossed collars, wide sleeves rolled once at the cuff, the borders embroidered in gold with flying geese, a sunset-gold gauze shawl over one arm; a pressed red maple leaf, almost black-red, at the collar. Hands and objects: both hands hold a bundle of green leaves tied with red thread, with a small round painted mark on the tie. Power: soft green and ochre motes of qi float among the leaves like fireflies, and a gentle green glow lies round her hands. Background: green herb terraces climbing behind her in soft mist to a red maple at the top. Light: warm golden light from the upper left with a faint spirit-glow on the leaves and a rim along her cheek. Expression: a pleasant, kind smile with the eyes sliding sideways to check whether it has worked, practised charm.

people.imagined: On a rope bridge with a coil of rope over his shoulder. The rope-sellers say a bridge could fall on that face and not improve it. He pays a boy to carry his bids.
people.subject: The moment: on a rope bridge he turns with a heavy self-conscious frown, a coil of rope on his shoulder, as a ferry girl has looked away from his face while he ties a knot he does not need. Face: a very homely face: a lumpy, crooked nose; asymmetric small eyes; a large drooping lower lip; a heavy jaw with a wen on it; thick untidy brows; sallow skin with pockmarks; a purple birthmark covering the left cheek; a cauliflowered left ear. Hair: coarse black, cropped short, held by a plain rust headband. Body: stout, short-legged and broad, with very long arms. Clothing: layered silk robes, a rust outer robe with a pale ochre under-robe and two crossed collars, sleeves rolled, borders embroidered in gold with flying geese, a sunset-gold gauze sash; clean and quietly well made, rope fibres clinging to the cuffs. Hands and objects: a heavy coil of brown hemp rope over one shoulder; both hands, thick and rope-burnt, hold the rope. Power: faint ochre and green motes of qi gather along the coil and his fingers, glimmering as the rope sways. Background: a rope bridge swaying in mist over a gorge, the gorge below white with fog tinted gold by sunset. Light: bright light from the upper left with a soft glow of mist around him and a thin rim along the rope. Expression: self-conscious, kind and plain, a man used to being avoided and kind in spite of it.

people.imagined: In the empty halls of the old seat, oiling a maple stump by the light of the window, a moth-eaten sleeve trailing.
people.subject: The moment: in an empty hall in autumn he kneels beside a cut maple stump with an oil cloth and glances up at the viewer, oiling the last stump for the thirtieth time by the light of the window. Face: a thin, dry, weathered face with pale skin, deep lines, patient faded brown eyes, sparse grey brows, a thin mouth, a long jaw and a small mole on the chin. Hair: fine grey hair, wispy and sparse, pulled into a small knot at the crown with a plain pale pin. Body: lean, long and bent at the back, kneeling with great care, one hand on his knee. Clothing: a clean pale ochre robe of old, soft, carefully kept silk with two crossed collars, a rust sash, a thin sunset-gold gauze over-robe of an old steward folding in quiet pleats, and the cuffs embroidered in faded gold flying geese; a faint smell of camellia oil clings to him. Hands and objects: one hand holds a cloth shining with camellia oil; the other rests on a pale maple stump whose rings are dark and glossy. Power: a faint, tender glow of ochre earth qi and a few green-gold motes rise from the stump as if the dead tree remembered. Background: a long empty hall with pale dusty floors, tall silent pillars and motes turning in a sunbeam. Light: a pale sunbeam from the upper left with a soft spirit-glow around the wood. Expression: peaceful and stubborn, the eyes soft and the thin mouth at rest, a loyal man content to keep a dead tree polished for a house that will not come back.

people.imagined: In the guest house on the Cloud Bridge, bringing tea so softly that the buyer starts. She says the last buyer paid more.
people.subject: The moment: in the guest house she holds out a cup of tea, having just spoken so softly that the viewer starts, and smiles gently; she has already said the last buyer paid more. Face: a soft, pale, pretty face; round gentle eyes slightly slanted with long lashes; fine brows; a small gentle smile with a faint dimple at the corner; skin powdered a little too pale; a faint knowing look. Hair: black, in a smooth low coil with a silver pin and a single strand of black pearls wound once through it. Body: slender, graceful and slow moving, she glides rather than walks. Clothing: layered silk, a pale ochre under-robe, a rust over-robe and a dusk-violet sash, two crossed collars, wide sleeves bordered in gold with sunset clouds and flying geese, a sunset-gold gauze scarf drifting from her elbows; soft grey felt slippers that make no sound. Hands and objects: both hands hold out a lacquered red tea tray, a small chip at one corner, with one thin white porcelain cup with a hairline gold rim, steam curling from it. Power: a faint soft haze of ochre and green qi curls off the steam, hardly more than a warmth in the air. Background: a guest room with a window framing a misty gorge and a rope bridge, blurred. Light: soft grey-gold window light from the left, a pale glow on the porcelain and a thin rim of light along her cheek. Expression: gentle, soft-spoken and artful.

people.imagined: At a ranch gate collecting late tribute, a ledger-case chained to his wrist. He says nothing until the figures agree.
people.subject: The moment: at a ranch gate he holds up his chained wrist with the ledger-case and gives the viewer a flat cold stare; he has been thrown off the ranch twice and stands at the gate once more. Face: a hard, narrow, pale face; a thin cruel mouth with a cold sore on the lip; flat grey eyes; thin straight brows; a sharp nose; a hollow cheek. Hair: black, cropped so close the skin shows grey through it, a small scar parting it above the right ear, under a severe plain silver crown. Body: lean, tall and rigid, held like a drawn bowstring. Clothing: the austere robes of an elder: dusk-violet silk of the finest weave in layered folds, two crossed collars buttoned to the throat with three bone toggles, a dark rust sash knotted tightly, a thin sunset-gold gauze over-robe without embroidery, no ornament of any kind. Hands and objects: on the left wrist a thin steel chain with square links fastened to a flat black leather case the size of a book, edged in iron, clearly visible; the right hand rests on the case. Power: a cold, tight shimmer of ochre-gold earth qi lies close to his skin, a few motes drifting heavily toward the ground. Background: a wooden ranch gate with a brand and yellow steppe grass behind, a pale sky with a thin evening mist. Light: flat cold silver light from the upper left, no warmth in it, with a hard rim on his collar. Expression: a flat, cold stare, the mouth a straight dry line; the face does not move at all while he waits for the figures.

people.imagined: Squatting at the edge of a flooded rice paddy, talking to a seedling as if it were a person, mud on his knees.
people.subject: The moment: squatting at the edge of a flooded rice paddy, he glances up from talking to a seedling and smiles at the viewer, telling it that it will be all right, mud on his knees. Face: a round, tanned, honest face with kind dark eyes, thick brows, a wide easy smile, a smear of mud on one cheek and streaking one ear. Hair: black, tied in a rough knot with a leaf of last year's rice straw stuck in it and short hairs standing up at the crown. Body: sturdy, short and square, squatting with his knees wide and forearms on thighs. Clothing: a rust silk robe with a faded dusk-violet vest and two crossed collars, the hem tied up and the wide sleeves rolled, gold flying geese on the borders, a thin sunset-gold gauze sash; muddy to the knee but clean above. Hands and objects: both hands cup a single young rice seedling, bright green, its roots wrapped in dark wet mud between his palms and three pale green leaves trembling. Power: soft green and ochre motes of qi float up from the seedling and drift around his hands like fireflies, and the water glows faintly green. Background: flooded paddies with green rows, silver water carrying the reflection of a pale sky, a soft gold morning mist. Light: bright morning light from the upper left, the paddies throwing white sky back up under his chin, soft rim light on his hair. Expression: a gentle, content smile that suits the seedling, the eyes soft and unhurried, an honest man to whom rice is a kind of person.

people.imagined: At the edge of the miasma with a map, coughing dryly into a sleeve. One cheek is burnt dark. She has measured forty paces more.
people.subject: The moment: at the miasma's edge she turns from a map with a dry cough into one sleeve and then looks at the viewer, having coughed twice and written another mark after measuring forty paces more. Face (most important: the left cheek burnt dark brown-black in a large patch, glossy like polished walnut): a thin, sunken, grey-tanned face with small tired dark eyes, thin brows and a thin mouth. Hair: black, in a low knot under a grey silk scarf stained brown at the edge, held by a plain jade pin. Body: thin, bent a little and tense, shoulders curled inward. Clothing: a grey gauze coat in several drifting layers over a rust robe with a dusk-violet collar, the silk soaked in tincture and faintly stained, a grey veil at the neck, the cuffs bordered in muted gold flying geese. Hands and objects: one hand holds up a hand-drawn map on yellow paper with a ring of small black dots and no writing; the other covers her mouth. Power: a thin, tired shimmer of ochre earth qi and a few pale blue motes drift about her hands as if feeling the air, bright against the grey. Background: a bank of grey miasma mist hiding the ash plain, a faint green lantern light, blurred. Light: pale green-grey spirit-light from the left with a thin cold rim along her hair. Expression: a tired, steady, cautious resolve, the eyes dull and the mouth thin, a woman who will keep drawing the line however much it costs her to breathe.

people.imagined: Asleep in the butt-store half an hour after dawn; woken, he lifts a bow, one shoulder higher than the other, and yawns.
people.subject: The moment: in the butt-store half an hour after dawn, woken from sleep, he lifts a bow and yawns widely, bleary and good-natured, testing the string with the ball of his thumb. Face: a long, lazy, tanned face with sleepy half-closed eyes, calm brows, a long nose, a mouth open mid-yawn and a day's growth of grey stubble. Hair: black going grey, in a loose knot with strands escaped and one grey lock hanging over the left ear. Body: tall, with the right shoulder drawn clearly a hand higher than the left, visible in the silhouette. Clothing: a slightly crumpled rust silk jacket over a dusk-violet robe with crossed collars and wide sleeves, borders in gold with flying geese, a thin sunset-gold gauze over-robe slipping off one shoulder, a grey goose-feather pin at the collar and an arm guard cracked and polished with use. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a long horn bow upright, the waxed yellow-brown string under his thumb; a quiver with three grey goose-fletched arrows leans beside him. Power: a faint haze of ochre earth qi with a few silver-white motes of metal qi gathers along the bow, fading as he yawns. Background: a dim store with straw archery butts stacked to the roof and stray feathers drifting in a gold haze. Light: soft dim light from the upper left, a narrow dusty beam from a gap in the roof falling across his chest and the bow with a glow of spirit-dust. Expression: lazy, peaceable and calm, the yawn stretching the whole face and not a trace of embarrassment, a man at ease with being half asleep.

people.imagined: At the old seat's outer gate, laughing at a joke told a minute ago, long after everyone else has stopped.
people.subject: The moment: in the old courtyard he bursts out laughing late at a joke told a minute ago, head thrown back, then looks at the viewer with a broad, delay-eyed grin. Face: a big, broad, slow face with tanned skin, wide round eyes crinkled with laughter, thick grey brows, a wide red-tinged nose, a wide laughing mouth, a double chin and deep laugh lines. Hair: grey-black, in a plain knot slightly undone, a short stray grey hair standing on top, held by a pale jade pin. Body: large, heavy and comfortable, his belly shaking as he laughs. Clothing: the generous robes of the oldest inner disciple: dusk-violet silk over a clean pale ochre under-robe, two crossed collars, enormous wide sleeves with gold flying geese and sunset clouds along the borders, a rust sash, a flowing sunset-gold gauze over-robe, chalk on the cuffs. Hands and objects: one hand slaps his knee, leaving a white chalk mark on the dark silk; the other holds a rolled letter tied with a bit of red thread, its seal unbroken. Power: a warm, broad glow of ochre and gold earth qi spills around him as he laughs, with slow motes of gold rising like dust in sunshine. Background: a courtyard of pale stones with the grey stumps of maples beyond in morning mist. Light: warm morning sun low from the left lighting one side of his round face and making the stone yard glow, a soft golden rim along his shoulders. Expression: slow, content delight, the eyes streaming and the mouth wide, a stubborn good nature that gets there last and enjoys it most.

people.imagined: At a market talisman contest, quick hands flying, ink on her fingertips. A red jasper seal on a cord bounces at her wrist as she finishes a sheet before the others have begun.
people.subject: The moment: at a market talisman contest she lifts a finished sheet of blank-faced talisman paper with a bright quick grin at the viewer, a red jasper seal swinging on a cord at her wrist; the sheet is done before the others have wetted their brushes. Face: a small, quick, sharp young face; light golden skin; bright dark eyes full of energy; slim arched brows; a small nose; a wide eager smile; ink on the cheek; a tiny dimple in the left cheek; small pink ears. Hair: black, in two high buns each bound with three turns of red thread and silver pins, a loose wisp over her left ear. Body: small, light, quick, always in motion, on tiptoe and leaning over the table. Clothing: the finest inner-gate silk: a rust robe with a dusk-violet collar and two crossed collars, a short jacket with wide sleeves tied up with red cord and ink-spattered at the cuffs, borders embroidered in gold with flying geese and sunset clouds, a sunset-gold gauze over-robe floating behind her. Hands and objects: ink-black fingertips on both hands; on the right wrist a square red jasper seal, the size of a thumb, on a thin cord, clearly visible; the left hand holds up the paper with a few loose grey swirls and no characters. Power: bright motes of ochre earth qi, green wood qi and blue water qi swirl round her fingers and the sheet, the paper glowing faintly, the brightest light in the frame. Background: market stalls and red awnings above rows of contest tables, a crowd of onlookers in blurred hats. Light: bright warm light from the upper left with a spirit-glow on the paper. Expression: brave, bright and entirely without malice, as if the win is a pleasant surprise.

people.imagined: Training alone at dusk on the outer-gate ground until sent to bed, with a small child's shoe tied at her belt. She wipes her face and keeps going.
people.subject: The moment: in the dusk on a bare practice ground she lowers a wooden practice spear and stares hard at the viewer, breathing hard, the steward's bell for bed not yet rung and the straw dummy waiting for one more attack, a small child's shoe tied at her belt. Face: a thin, sunburnt, sharp face with high cheekbones, fierce dark red-rimmed eyes, thick straight brows, a set mouth, a peeling nose and a faint white line of old scab on the lower lip. Hair: black, in a rough high ponytail tied with a strip cut from a child's blue silk sash. Body: thin and wiry with squared shoulders, sharp elbows and scabbed knees under the rolled hem. Clothing: the simplest outer-gate robe, pale ochre silk with a single crossed collar, the sleeves tied back with cords, a thin border embroidered with tiny gold flying geese, the collar and back darkened with sweat; clean and plain. Hands and objects: both hands grip a wooden practice spear; tied at her belt by its worn lace, one tiny brown scuffed child's shoe, the left of a pair, clearly visible. A wooden practice sword hangs slung across her back by a leather strap, its hilt wrapped in cord above the left shoulder, the blade worn smooth by drilling. Power: a single thin thread of pale blue and ochre qi rises from her breath and the spear tip, faint in the dusk. Background: a dusty practice yard, a line of straw dummies leaning in the dust, a row of lit lamps at the far gate under a dim red sunset in layered cloud. Light: low red dusk light from the upper left with a faint spirit-glow on the spear. Expression: fierce, red-eyed and dry, the mouth set and the stare absolutely fixed, grief turned into discipline.

people.imagined: In a courtyard, a courteous bow in an old-fashioned clan robe with swallows at the hem. He is calm and he has made up his mind about where he will not go.
people.subject: The moment: in a courtyard a senior has passed and he gives the polished courteous half-bow he has practised, looking up calmly at the viewer. Face: a smooth, fine-featured, courteous face; fair skin with a faint blush on the cheekbones; calm clear dark eyes; thin elegant brows; a straight nose; a gentle polite smile with a faint hidden stiffness; a delicate jaw. Hair: black, in a neat tall knot with a plain jade pin, one thin braid falling over his left shoulder. Body: slim, tall, very upright, arms held exactly level and spine perfectly vertical. Clothing: an old-fashioned clan robe of pale blue-grey silk with long wide sleeves lined in pale grey and a high crossed collar; along the hem a row of six small swallows with forked tails stitched in dark blue silk, clearly visible; over it a pale ochre outer-gate vest with a thin border of gold flying geese, a slender jade pendant at his sash. Hands and objects: both hands clasped in a bow at his chest, the wide sleeves hanging. Power: a few faint green motes of wood qi and pale blue water qi float around his sleeves like drifting petals, quiet and well governed. Background: an old courtyard with maples dropping a few orange leaves on grey flagstones, a soft sunset-coloured mist beyond. Light: soft light from the upper left with a gentle silver rim along the sleeves. Expression: courteous, calm and quietly evasive, his politeness complete and hiding an absolute refusal.

people.imagined: Lying propped on an ore cart, bored of being asked about his sister, chewing a straw, in no hurry for anything.
people.subject: The moment: slouched against an ore cart and chewing a straw, he looks lazily at the viewer; a passer-by has asked whose brother he is and he takes the straw out of his mouth to sigh. Face: a broad, easy, round face with a wide high forehead like his sister's; light brown skin; heavy-lidded relaxed eyes; thick brows; a lazy half-smile; a round soft chin. Hair: black, tied in a loose knot sitting crooked on the crown with a wooden-looking pale pin that is not quite straight. Body: sturdy, loose, slouching, belly soft and shoulders sloping. Clothing: a pale ochre outer-gate robe of soft silk with a single crossed collar, loosened at the throat, wide sleeves rolled, a border of small gold flying geese, the belt tied in a lazy bow, an ochre ribbon trailing; clean and plain. Hands and objects: one hand holds a long yellow straw chewed flat at the end between his teeth; the other rests on the rim of an ore cart, the palm open as if to say it is not his doing. Power: a few drowsy motes of ochre earth qi and pale green qi drift lazily over his shoulder, barely there. Background: a market yard of piled ore sacks, a donkey asleep, a warm gold haze. Light: warm bright light from the upper left, laying a long shadow of the cart across the dusty ground and a soft rim along his hair. Expression: lazy, friendly and unhurried, with complete good-humoured disinterest.

people.imagined: Lifting a robe out of the founder's madder dye pot, red to both elbows, patient. Steam and a dusk sky behind her.
people.subject: The moment: at a big copper dye pot she lifts out a dripping dusk-coloured robe with both arms and smiles gently at the viewer, red to both elbows, patient, as a cloud of steam parts. Face: a plump, kind, lined face; warm brown eyes; soft thin brows; a gentle content smile; red spatters on one cheek; fine lines fanning from the eyes; a red fleck on the left eyebrow. Hair: grey-black, covered by a soft head cloth of silk stained red. Body: short, round, strong in the arms, shoulders broad from lifting wet cloth, back straight. Clothing: a plain, clean rust robe of good silk with a single crossed collar and sleeves pushed above the elbow with a wet cord, a plain pale apron stained in every shade from rose to maroon, a thin gold border of flying geese at the hem; modest but graceful. Hands and objects: both forearms stained deep madder-red from fingertip to elbow, clearly visible; the dripping robe in her hands shades from violet to red-orange. Power: soft ochre and green motes of qi rise with the steam and the dye seems to glow gently from within, the colour running from violet to flame. Background: steaming copper vats and hanging dyed cloths in red, orange and violet dripping in lines behind a huge copper pot, in a sunset-coloured haze. Light: warm light from the upper left with the steam glowing red-gold and a soft rim of light on her shoulders. Expression: a soft, unhurried smile, eyes warm and half lowered toward the pot, cheeks flushed with steam; she looks at peace.

people.imagined: In oversized Watch plate hanging off his shoulders, standing on tiptoe to look as tall as his father. He is not allowed near the Watch.
people.subject: The moment: on tiptoe in a suit of plate far too large for him, he lifts his chin at the viewer with fierce pride, having stretched higher as his father went by, though he is not allowed near the Watch. Face: a small, thin, pale face with large earnest dark eyes, thick straight brows, a pinched jaw, a very small chin, a trembling brave mouth and ears that stick out beneath the helmet's rim. Hair: black, in a tiny topknot under the helmet's edge. Body: slight and slim, dwarfed by the armour, heels lifted off the floor and neck stretched. Clothing: a suit of ash-grey earth-iron plate hanging far too big from his shoulders, the pauldrons past his elbows, the breastplate's lower edge reaching his knees, the straps knotted twice, the sleeves covering his hands and the collar up to his ears, over a pale ochre outer-gate robe whose gold flying-goose border peeks at the neck. Hands and objects: both hands hidden inside the long iron cuffs, holding a spear twice his height whose tip wobbles. Power: a few faint ochre motes of earth qi shiver around the oversized plate as if the armour were only half awake. Background: the grey wall of the Watch house with a lantern hook and a small ladder, soft grey mist. Light: pale grey-gold light from the upper left with a thin glow on the plate's edges. Expression: a fierce, trembling pride with a dread of being sent away underneath it, the lip held firm and the eyes very bright.

people.imagined: Behind a market stall on a rest day with her bead bracelet clicking. She has just told a small lie and listens to her own bracelet.
people.subject: The moment: behind a small stall she tells a customer a smooth little lie with a sweet look at the viewer as her wrist bracelet clicks; the customer has asked the price and the lie comes smooth. Face: a pretty, round, lively face; light brown skin; bright quick eyes; arched brows; a small sweet pout; a gap-toothed smile; two small dimples and a slightly upturned nose. Hair: black, in two high bunches tied with orange silk cord. Body: small, quick and bouncy, leaning over the counter on both elbows. Clothing: a pale ochre outer-gate robe of fine silk with a single crossed collar, wide sleeves turned back twice with borders of small gold flying geese, a bright orange sash tied in a double bow. Hands and objects: on her right wrist a bracelet of many small wooden abacus beads in rows, clearly visible; her left hand holds up a handful of loose beads over a cloth. Power: a few small ochre and green motes jump off the beads with each click, tiny sparks that vanish. Background: a market stall with strings of loose beads hanging like curtains, awnings, a gold haze. Light: bright light from the upper left, a beam through the awning lighting the beads and a soft rim along her cheek. Expression: sweet, greedy and fickle, all sweetness with a flicker of fear when the bracelet clicks.

people.imagined: Leaning in toward a sunny wall as if it might hand her something. Hope on her face for the new seat's Wood.
people.subject: The moment: a patch of sun has reached the wall at last and she leans her whole body toward it with eyes closed, then opens them to smile hopefully at the viewer, hoping the new seat will give her Wood. Face: a long, gentle, freckled face with light green-brown eyes, high lifted pale brows, a long nose, a hopeful smile and a gangly neck. Hair: brown, loose and flyaway, with a leaf from last year still caught in it. Body: tall, lanky and a little bent forward, bony shoulders and thin arms, so thin that the robe hangs like washing on a pole. Clothing: a clean pale ochre outer-gate robe of light silk with a single crossed collar and loose sleeves, green dye at the cuffs, a thin border of gold flying geese, and a sprout of wood-fern tucked in the collar with its stem soaked in water. Hands and objects: both hands rest flat against a warm yellow wall. Power: soft green motes of wood qi drift toward her palms like seeds and a faint green glow gathers where she touches the wall, the sprout at her collar quivering. Background: a yellow plaster wall with a window and the moving shadow of a maple's lower branches, in soft golden haze. Light: bright warm light from the upper left, the plaster wall throwing warm yellow back onto her face and leaf shadows moving on her cheek. Expression: hopeful to the point of ache, the eyes wide and the smile unguarded, a humble, trusting girl asking the wall for one small gift.

people.imagined: In the steppe plot at dawn, transplanting a spirit-rice seedling, one thumb bent for life. She looks up as her brother's name is mentioned.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling in the steppe plot at dawn, transplanting a spirit-rice seedling, she looks up with a mild smile as her brother's name comes up at the other end of the plot. Face: a round, freckled, mild face; tanned skin; honest brown eyes; thick light-brown brows; a soft smile; plump cheeks; a dab of mud on one cheek. Hair: brown, in a thick plait over one shoulder ending in a green silk cord. Body: sturdy and compact, kneeling with her skirts bunched up. Clothing: a pale ochre outer-gate robe of sturdy silk with a single crossed collar, the hem tied up and muddy at the knees, a thin gold border of flying geese at the cuffs; a flat straw hat hung at her back by a cotton string. Hands and objects: the right thumb is bent sideways at a permanent angle, plainly visible, holding a small bright green rice seedling. Power: a few green and ochre motes of qi float up from the seedling, soft and slow, and the wet soil gleams faintly. Background: a flooded plot with rows of bright green rice seedlings reaching to a pale horizon, in a grey-gold dawn mist. Light: soft cool dawn light from the upper left with a gentle glow on the seedling and a thin rim along her plait. Expression: a mild, easy half-smile as she looks up, eyes open and trusting, brows lifted a little at the sound of her brother's name.
